rules.sentence: The joints are frequently involved in the systemic inflammatory process of Sjögren’s syndrome, being affected in approximately 53% of patients.

Clinical manifestations range from arthralgia without objective inflammatory signs in the joints to inflammatory arthritis (16%)—most often non-erosive, or more rarely erosive, similar to that observed in rheumatoid arthritis (5%).
